summary: seed (vivekhaldar/seed) is a minimal single-file agent (seed.py, console script `seed` = seed:main). It uses Simon Willison's `llm` library with one tool, `exec` (bash in cwd), loads its system prompt from ./self/SELF.md, and runs a REPL reading user turns from stdin via input() until EOF, calling conversation.chain() for each turn. Model selection is `-m <llm model id>`. We route model calls to the proxy by registering an OpenAI-compatible chat model in llm's extra-openai-models.yaml (in LLM_USER_PATH) with api_base=$PROXY_URL/v1 and supports_tools: true, so llm's OpenAI Chat client (openai SDK, chat-completions, streaming + tools) talks only to the proxy. The task is piped in as a single stdin line; EOF then ends the session. The per-session transcript (self/sessions/*.json) is copied to /out.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=python:3.12-slim-bookworm
FROM ${BASE}
USER root
RUN apt-get update \
 && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
ENV UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/harness/python \
    UV_CACHE_DIR=/opt/harness/uv-cache \
    UV_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1
RUN mkdir -p /opt/harness/bin \
 && curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | env UV_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/harness/bin UV_NO_MODIFY_PATH=1 sh \
 && /opt/harness/bin/uv python install 3.12
COPY . /opt/harness/src
RUN /opt/harness/bin/uv venv --python 3.12 /opt/harness/venv \
 && /opt/harness/bin/uv pip install --python /opt/harness/venv/bin/python /opt/harness/src \
 && ln -sf /opt/harness/venv/bin/seed /opt/harness/bin/seed \
 && ln -sf /opt/harness/venv/bin/llm /opt/harness/bin/llm \
 && rm -rf /opt/harness/uv-cache \
 && chmod -R a+rX /opt/harness
ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:$PATH
run_command:
mkdir -p /out/llm
cat > /out/llm/extra-openai-models.yaml <<EOF
- model_id: proxy-model
  model_name: gpt-4o
  api_base: "$PROXY_URL/v1"
  api_key_name: openai
  supports_tools: true
EOF
printf '%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$TASK" | tr '\r\n' '  ')" | seed -m proxy-model 2>&1 | tee /out/seed-console.log
rc=${PIPESTATUS[1]}
mkdir -p /out/sessions && cp -r self/sessions/. /out/sessions/ 2>/dev/null || true
exit $rc
notes:
- seed.py's REPL reads each turn with input(), so a multi-line $TASK would turn into several separate turns. The run command joins the task into one line (newlines become spaces) and pipes it in. EOF then ends the session cleanly with exit 0.
- The model id "proxy-model" is registered at run time in $LLM_USER_PATH/extra-openai-models.yaml, with api_base set to the real $PROXY_URL/v1 and supports_tools: true. llm then uses its OpenAI Chat class (chat-completions). The file is written at run time because $PROXY_URL is only known then. The upstream model name sent is gpt-4o, and the proxy replaces it anyway.
- Side effects the harness has by design, which can't be avoided without modifying it:
  - It copies seed.py and run_seed.sh into cwd and creates self/SELF.md.
  - If cwd is not a git repo, it runs `git init` in cwd and makes a "genesis" commit with those files. If cwd is already a repo, it nests the git repo inside self/ instead.
  - The GIT_AUTHOR/COMMITTER env vars are set so that commit doesn't fail on a missing identity (it runs with check=True). safe.directory=* avoids ownership errors.
  - git comes from apt, or is already there in buildpack-deps.
- Trajectory: self/sessions/<timestamp>.json (verbatim llm responses, updated after each turn) is copied to /out/sessions/. Console output is teed to /out/seed-console.log.
- The runtime is self-contained under /opt/harness: uv, uv-managed CPython 3.12, and a venv with seed-agent plus llm and its plugins. The base image's python is not touched.
- Static verification only: I couldn't execute the installed package here because local sandbox permissions blocked it. The llm code confirms that api_base goes to the openai client's base_url and that api_key_name=openai reads OPENAI_API_KEY.
